fieldValues.title: The corpus counts in epic #556 are stale; the RFC cites measured ones
fieldValues.summary: The epic's headline numbers (127 baked headings, 101 fenced blocks) no longer match the corpus. Measured on the 2026-09-06 origin/master worktree: 159 baked headings and 112 fenced blocks. The RFC cites the measured figures, not the epic's.
evidence: Measured on the #620 worktree: 159 headings baked in prose across spec records (119 of them in 21 section/subsection records); 112 fenced blocks (73 in section/subsection)
Also measured: 10 sections, 65 subsections, 119 invariants, 44 concepts; 159 contains, 137 precedes, 90 depends-on edges
fieldValues.body: The corpus moves while the epic that describes it does not. Any unit that quotes a count from an issue body is quoting a measurement taken at an unknown date. Re-measure on the worktree and cite that; the divergence here was roughly 25 per cent in under a month.
